fieldValues.title: Mozilla Foundation, Human-Scale AI Incubator
fieldValues.summary: The owner's next immediate funding audience. Up to US$500,000 over three years for bespoke technology already deployed with the people it serves; a 12-month cohort from April 2027. Search summaries of the call give a deadline of 2026-11-20, 11:59 p.m. PST, and an info webinar on 2026-11-12.
source_ref: https://www.mozillafoundation.org/en/what-we-do/grantmaking/incubator/human-scale-ai/cohort/ (refused automated fetches on 2026-11-04; call details below come from search summaries)
